## Description

Use English with a clear and concise description of the bug. If you just have a question or need help, please submit it to [Discussions](https://github.com/longbridge/native-shell/discussions).

## Environment

- NSH: [e.g., `nsh --version`, or the commit]
- Platform: [e.g., iOS 26 on iPhone 17 Pro, iOS simulator, Mac Catalyst, Android 16 on Pixel 9, Android emulator]
- How it runs: [e.g., `nsh run`, `nsh package`, embedded in an app]

## Steps to Reproduce

The smallest `App.tsx` that shows the problem, then:

1. Tap '...'
2. Scroll to '....'
3. See error

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots or recordings to help explain your problem.

## Expected

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual

A clear and concise description of what actually happened, with the logs of `nsh run` if any.
